# mergeah Provider

Manage the Merge Agent Handler management plane.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    mergeah = {
      source = "bogware/mergeah"
    }
  }
}

# Set MERGEAH_API_KEY in the environment.
provider "mergeah" {
  api_url = "https://ah-api.merge.dev/api/v1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Merge access key. Defaults to MERGEAH_API_KEY. Requires management permissions.
- `api_url` (String) API base URL including /api/v1. Defaults to MERGEAH_API_URL, then https://ah-api.merge.dev/api/v1. For EU use https://ah-api-eu.merge.dev/api/v1. HTTPS is required except for loopback IP addresses used by local fixtures.
